meta.title: invot teih martx
meta.author: Teo (Rebels)
meta.description: The soundtrack of invot teih martx by Rebels (2022-11-18). A 64K intro that won the Modern Demo competition at Demosplash 2022. Music credited to Teo on Demozoo. 100 BPM, 3:12, 39 tracks, 4092 notes. Instruments: 3 Falcon (FM synth), 6 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 4 Adultery (GM.DLS sampler), 9 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 6 Scissor, 4 Echo, 7 Smasher, 5 Chamber. Its Adultery instruments play waves from the Windows GM.DLS bank: they sound as intended only with that bank (GM_DLS=<path to gm.dls>); macOS's own GS bank has other waves. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.17 dB loudness and at most 0.60 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. Teo gave permission (2026-11-09) to publish his music here as adapted versions; the music belongs to him and is removed at his request.
